overview.en:
Connect HiBob’s official MCP with employee OAuth for people, organization, time-off and workplace workflows.

Review available people or recruiting information within the connected organization's scope. Use a specific record or workflow and prepare summaries that keep missing information visible.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
通过员工 OAuth 连接 HiBob 官方 MCP，处理人员、组织、休假与办公工作流。

在已连接组织范围内查看人员或招聘信息，围绕具体记录或流程准备摘要，并明确缺失信息。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize the available information for this person or candidate record.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 汇总这个员工或候选人记录的可用信息。

starterPrompts.en: Review this people workflow and identify the next required steps.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查看这个人员流程，列出下一步需要完成的事项。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare a briefing from these records without changing them.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 根据这些记录准备简报，先不要修改记录。

descriptions.en: Use HiBob in Ghast. Connect HiBob’s official MCP with employee OAuth for people, organization, time-off and workplace workflows. 通过员工 OAuth 连接 HiBob 官方 MCP，处理人员、组织、休假与办公工作流。
